## Checklist

- [ ] Only base forms (lemmas): noun in nominative singular; adjective in nominative singular masculine.
- [ ] No proper nouns, no abbreviations, no Russianisms or surzhyk.
- [ ] Each word is placed in the file matching its first letter.
- [ ] All `tags` used already exist in [`tags.json`](../blob/main/tags.json). If a new tag was needed, it was added in this PR with a brief rationale below.
- [ ] Apostrophes use `’` (U+2019), not `'` or `ʼ`.
- [ ] Ran `node scripts/validate.mjs` locally — it passed.
- [ ] Did **not** modify `VERSION` (unless this is a maintainer MINOR/MAJOR bump).
